[[Cerise Island]] }} '''Airing Out Aerodactyl''' (Japanese: '''VSプテラ①''' ''VS {{tt|Ptera|Aerodactyl}} 1'') is the 79th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 39th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} One of the {{p|Haunter}} in [[Cerulean City]] spots [[Misty's Starmie]] rotating in the sky and throws giant boulders at it. It, however, gets tossed away by a {{p|Krabby}}. [[Erika]] tells [[Misty]] that the Pokémon are destroying certain cities. Misty thinks it's over and comes to realize that the Pokémon are destroying cities with [[Gyms]]. Inside [[Cerise Island]], {{adv|Blaine}} wakes up and awakens {{adv|Yellow}}. Yellow remembers that she has lost {{adv|Red}}'s [[Pokédex]] in the cave. Suddenly, a tremble courses through the cave, and the ground suddenly jags up and pushes Blaine and Yellow out onto the island surface. [[Lance]] laughs that the cave is too small a battle arena for {{adv|Mewtwo}}, and proceeds to command a {{m|Supersonic}} from his {{p|Aerodactyl}}. Mewtwo quickly creates a {{m|Barrier}} to fend off the giant sound waves, and Yellow starts to get worried. Blaine tells her to relax, and says they should first learn of the enemy's power by taking a defensive approach. Mewtwo continues to deflect the Supersonic with its Barrier, and Blaine secretly wonders how much longer his body can stand commanding Mewtwo. ==Major events== * [[Misty]] and [[Erika]] find out the Elite Four's motive. * {{adv|Blaine}} battles against [[Lance]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Blaine}} * [[Misty]] * [[Erika]] * [[Lance]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Pika]]; {{adv|Yellow}}'s) * {{p|Mewtwo}} ({{adv|Mewtwo|Blaine's}}) * {{p|Growlithe}} ({{adv|Blaine}}'s) * {{p|Geodude}} ({{OP|Brock|Geodude}}) * {{p|Starmie}} ({{OP|Misty|Starmie}}) * {{p|Krabby}} ([[Misty]]'s) * {{p|Tangela}} ([[Erika]]'s) * {{p|Shellder}} ([[Lorelei]]'s; multiple) * {{p|Cloyster}} ({{OP|Lorelei|Cloyster}}; multiple) * {{p|Gengar}} ({{OP|Agatha|Gengar}}; multiple) * {{p|Haunter}} ([[Agatha]]'s) * {{p|Aerodactyl}} ([[Lance]]'s) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{yellow color light}}|bordercolor={{yellow color}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 化石翼龍①|VS Aerodactyl 1}} (Taiwan)
